limitations: The first b6c363a3 attempt proved the real journey but was rejected because the unclassified 503 traffic was treated as an unexpected server error; it remains a failed harness iteration, not PASS.

D44 proves one local single-broker restart and checkpoint-resume path. It does not prove multi-broker quorum recovery, sustained backpressure, worker supervision, external providers or the full P11 family journey.
No gate closes and release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
